result.instructions: Tools for Silvasoft, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which customers still have outstanding Silvasoft invoices, and how much is due?"; "Show the sales invoices from last month with their totals."; "Find the product with article number SKU-1204 and show its stock per warehouse.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Silvasoft data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run silvasoft_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run silvasoft_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run silvasoft_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. silvasoft_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: silvasoft_list_relations
tools.title: List relations
tools.description: List customers and suppliers (relations) with contact and address details. Returns at most 200 per call; use Offset with a stable Sorting to page. Silvasoft API: GET listrelations/.

relationVat.description: VAT number without country code and without VAT additions. Business relations only.

offset.description: Number of items to skip, for paging.

sorting.description: Sort field. Sort on CustomerNumber only with relationType Customer, and SupplierNumber only with Supplier.

tools.name: silvasoft_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List products (articles) with price, VAT and stock quantity. Use ArticleNumber or EAN for one exact product. Silvasoft API: GET listproducts.

articleNumber.description: Exact article number. Returns at most one product.

ean.description: Exact EAN code. Returns at most one product.

offset.description: Number of items to skip, for paging.

includeStockPositions.description: Include stock per warehouse, shelf and batch (default false).

tools.name: silvasoft_list_orders
tools.title: List sales orders
tools.description: List sales orders, filtered by order date, change or creation time, or custom status. Silvasoft API: GET listorders/.

dateFrom.description: Orders dated on or after this date.

orderStatus.description: Custom order status name in Silvasoft.

htmlAsPlainText.description: Return rich-text fields as plain text (default false).

offset.description: Number of items to skip, for paging.

tools.name: silvasoft_list_sales_invoices
tools.title: List sales invoices
tools.description: List sales invoices, with optional invoice lines. Use InvoiceNumber for one invoice, or dates and OutstandingOnly to filter. Lines return at most 50 invoices per call. Silvasoft API: GET listsalesinvoices/.

outstandingOnly.description: Only invoices that are not fully paid (default false).

includeInvoiceLines.description: Include invoice lines (default false). Limits the result to 50 invoices.

offset.description: Number of items to skip, for paging.

tools.name: silvasoft_list_purchase_transactions
tools.title: List purchase invoices
tools.description: List purchase invoices (supplier invoices) by number or date. Silvasoft API: GET listpurchasetransactions/.

offset.description: Number of items to skip, for paging.

tools.name: silvasoft_list_tax_codes
tools.title: List tax codes
tools.description: List the tax codes configured in the administration, with their rate. Silvasoft API: GET listtaxcodes/.

tools.name: silvasoft_list_ledger_accounts
tools.title: List ledger accounts
tools.description: List ledger accounts (grootboekrekeningen) for a fiscal year. Without FiscalYear, returns the latest year. Silvasoft API: GET listledgeraccounts/.

fiscalYear.description: Fiscal year. Default: the latest year.

tools.name: silvasoft_list_day_registrations
tools.title: List time registrations
tools.description: List day registrations (hours worked per user and day) for a date range. Silvasoft API: GET listdayregistrations/.

accountEmail.description: Only registrations of this user's e-mail.

offset.description: Number of items to skip, for paging.

tools.name: silvasoft_add_business_relation
tools.title: Add a business relation
tools.description: Create a business customer or supplier. If a relation with the same e-mail, name or number exists, Silvasoft returns that relation and creates nothing. Silvasoft API: POST addbusinessrelation/.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 country code, for example NL.

prompts.title: Get started with Silvasoft
prompts.description: What you can do with Silvasoft here, with example requests to try.
